description: Per-coin market snapshot (spot price, perpetual mark price, 24h change, funding rate, open interest, long/short ratio, 24h liquidations), merged across providers. Spot and perp prices are separate fields (spot from spot-market providers, perp mark from the perp venue); they differ by the basis. Pass 'symbols' to filter to specific coins; omit it for every covered coin.

symbols.description: Coin symbols to include, e.g. ["BTC","ETH"]. Omit for all covered coins.

name: market_quotes

perpPriceUsd.description: Perpetual mark price, USD; 0 when no perp venue covers the coin

priceUsd.description: Canonical price, USD: spot when available, else perp mark

spotPriceUsd.description: Spot/index price, USD; 0 when no spot source covers the coin

title: Market Quotes
